title: Koi Pond
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael hosts a Halloween haunted house event for local children and later struggles with embarrassment after falling into a koi pond during a business meeting at Raskin Design. Meanwhile, Jim and Andy navigate sales calls with mixed success, and the office engages in a sensitivity training session to create a 'Do Not Mock' list. The episode explores themes of personal embarrassment, workplace relationships, and the challenges of sales and social interactions.
